title: DOT-06: GAO-23-105189 Recommendation 1 implementation artifact and milestone record — Phase 65 Aviation review
summary: Phase 65 reviews this primary record as part of the Aviation reporting pack. GAO-23-105189 Recommendation 1 remains Open. Its normalized follow-through state is Promised; the record separates the named artifact, visibility, milestone, GAO review state, and remaining gap.
key_findings: Current GAO status: Open; status period: March 2026.

Response artifact: FAA Drone Normalization Strategy Report Update 2026. A public updated strategy is available, but the current GAO page still records only FAA's plan to submit a revised strategy and does not record GAO acceptance.
Artifact availability: Public official artifact located.
Named milestone: June 30, 2026; milestone state: Elapsed; GAO page has no review update.
GAO review state: GAO acceptance not recorded.
Remaining gap: GAO confirmation that the revised strategy contains all seven elements of a comprehensive strategy.

Continuation rule: Recheck the official GAO page for its review of the public updated strategy. Preserve DOT-06 as the parent crosswalk; do not translate an artifact, promise, submission, or GAO review into implementation, closure, or operating outcome.
why_it_matters: Which records separate plans, rules, trials, and workforce processes from certification, accepted service, recurring operations, and comparable reliability? This record supplies one bounded part of that evidence chain; it is not a substitute for the pack's downstream records. Recommendation-specific follow-through makes it possible to distinguish a promise, an available artifact, a submission, GAO review, partial addressing, implementation, closure, and later operating outcomes.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves DOT-06 as the parent crosswalk.
Records public artifact availability without treating availability as sufficiency or implementation.
Keeps named dates as monitors that do not pause the active content queue.
evidence_limits: Inclusion in a Phase 65 reporting pack does not advance a Phase 64 matrix cell or establish an operating outcome.
A promised milestone is a monitor, not implementation evidence.
An agency artifact or submission is not implementation unless its scope satisfies the recommendation and the official record supports that conclusion.
Open – Partially Addressed is an official recommendation status, not the Phase 56F Partially Closed entity evidence state.
Recommendation closure would not by itself establish operating performance, readiness, safety, savings, value, or causation.
